review_candidates.title: Security Operations engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About The Role Provide Level 2 operational support by troubleshooting and solving faults reported through the Oceane ticketing system. About You At least 2 years of professional experience. At least 2 years of technical experience in IT or network security support. Very good troubleshooting skills.
eligibility_evidence: What We Offer Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: About You At least 2 years of professional experience. At least 2 years of technical experience in IT or network security support. Preferred certifications: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet and Palo Alto. Very good understanding and hands-on experience with Palo Alto and Fortinet firewalls, and holding relevant certifications. Understanding and hands-on experience with EIP DDI, Blue Coat and Pulse Secure SSL. You seek the opportunity to expand your expertise, achieve your goals, and thrive.
